rationale: Calculated 3-phase fault currents at three locations: near bus 9.376 kA, mid-feeder 3.104 kA, remote end 1.760 kA. Maximum is 9.376 kA. Minimum 2-phase fault is 1.525 kA at remote end. Breaker rating 12.5 kA exceeds 9.376 × 1.1 = 10.314 kA requirement and is the smallest available standard rating. Relay pickup 600 A satisfies load margin minimum (450 A) and fault sensitivity maximum (762.5 A).
